defects.title: A declared grouping field coded 0/1 in the file cannot be mapped: the column measures as continuous
defects.observed: preflight: Bound column "atteinte_pancreatique" for slot "groupingColumn" has a semantic role the slot does not accept. | role_mismatch: Field "atteinte_pancreatique" is declared grouping_two_levels but column "atteinte_pancreatique" measures as continuous. | level_not_measured: Declared level(s) "0", "1" of field "atteinte_pancreatique" are not measured in column "atteinte_pancreatique".
defects.expected: the plan declares atteinte_pancreatique as a grouping field with levels equal to the file values (FR12): conformance passes, or the Investigator is offered a way to confirm the role. Today only a dataset semantic declaration (PUT /discovery/datasets/:id/semantic-declaration, governs_analysis_parameters) can make the column a group, and the Investigator does not hold that right
defects.suspectedLocation: axiome-back sap/bindings/sap-binding-measured.ts measuredColumnsOf → guided-analysis/templates/opening/opening-template.columns.ts columnRolesOf/hasCategoricalLevels (numeric levels never categorical); sap-decision/conformance/binding-conformance.ts roleFindings/levelFindings
